title: Personal Loans Standing and PracticePay Returned-Payment Fees
content:
**Rule.** The personal-loan share of a PracticePay Patient Financing returned-payment fee reads every Larkspur personal loan the customer has held: when the customer holds an active personal loan and no late fee and no returned payment were posted on any of the customer's personal loans within the last 12 months, the share is 0.9; when the customer holds an active personal loan and a returned payment but no late fee was posted on any of them within the last 12 months, the share is 0.95; in every other case the share is 1; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the assessment date, a month being whole once the assessment date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

| Holds an active loan under Personal Loans | Personal-loan entries, last 12 months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no late fee, no returned payment | 0.9 |
| yes | returned payment, no late fee | 0.95 |
| yes | a late fee | 1 |
| no | anything | 1 |

*Hypothetical.* A customer whose only personal loan is paid off, with a clean record: no active personal loan, share 1.
